title: Computing the free energy of quantum Coulomb gases and molecules via quantum Gibbs sampling
summary: We develop a quantum Gibbs-sampling approach to free-energy estimation for trapped systems of distinguishable particles with Coulomb interactions in dimensions $d\in\{2,3\}$. The singular infinite-dimensional problem is reduced to a finite-rank low-energy truncation of the interaction, the truncated Gibbs state is prepared by a quantum Markov semigroup, and thermodynamic integration gives the free energy.
